_meta.description: Dominant arable soil archetype per department, used as the soil feature for model training and for the macro heatmap default. This is a COARSE single-archetype assignment: every real department contains several soil types, and a parcel-level request should always pass its own soil_type rather than rely on this default.
_meta.basis: Dominant arable pedology of each department's main cropping plain (Beauce limon, Champagne craie, groies calcaires, coteaux argilo-calcaires, boulbenes, sables de Sologne et des Landes).
